create_benchmark_instance: create a Benchmark instance to evaluate a habitat agent in a configured environment
run_local_evaluate: run local evaluation of a habitat agent across multiple episodes and return aggregated metrics
run_remote_evaluate: run remote evaluation of a habitat agent via gRPC and return averaged metrics
run_benchmark_evaluate: run the Benchmark evaluate method to test an agent locally or remotely based on configuration
build_benchmark_with_config: build a Benchmark instance with a config file path and optional remote evaluation flag
